name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official annual information is available; Fall 2027 dates and a uniform admission model were not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: First priority
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual date; later applications considered if space remains.

applicationFee.note: Automatic waivers: McNair, Fulbright, US veterans/active-duty military, Syracuse students/alumni. Eligibility depends on membership; international applicants should confirm their category.

english.note: Official TOEFL or IELTS for international applicants using English as a second language. Department states no minimum TOEFL/IELTS score.

documents: Transcripts; unofficial copies accepted for review
Single personal-statement document: research interests (300–400 words), preparation (300–400), overcoming failure (200–250)
requirements.note: BS/BA required. Expected background: two years biology; one year each introductory chemistry, organic chemistry with laboratory, physics and calculus. List up to three potential faculty advisers. No minimum GPA. Optional GRE.

funding.note: PhD support for up to five years, typically academic-year teaching assistantship and tuition scholarship; research grants or fellowships are alternatives. No international-specific guarantee or summer stipend stated.
